name: jev-context-compaction
description: Low-latency Jev-guided compaction through the TypeSafe AI Rust SDK.

keepBudgetRatio.title: Keep budget ratio
keepBudgetRatio.description: Share of compactable tool-call characters kept, spent on the calls and full results Jev ranks highest.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest transcript messages protected from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

autoRetryDeltaPercent.title: Auto-compaction retry gap
autoRetryDeltaPercent.description: Minimum additional context percentage before retrying after an auto-compaction attempt.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the fitted Jev state.

maxCombinedTokens.title: Maximum combined tokens
maxCombinedTokens.description: Estimated budget for state and all questions in one request.

maxStateQuestionTokens.title: State and question limit
maxStateQuestionTokens.description: Estimated budget for state plus the longest question.

maxParallelRequests.title: Parallel request limit
maxParallelRequests.description: Maximum concurrent Jev calls when one request cannot fit all questions.

requestTimeoutMs.title: Request timeout
requestTimeoutMs.description: Jev request deadline in milliseconds before built-in fallback.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Leading result characters retained when the full result is dropped.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: TypeSafe System One model used for compaction judgments.
